citations.quote:
[name="林雨霞"]回客栈再说。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_299_1#1$1",duration =1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[name="太合"]林雨霞，留步。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_243_waaifu_1#2$1",focus="l")]
[charslot(slot = "right", name = "avg_npc_296_1#1$1",focus="n")]
[name="槐琥"]是这个人……？
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#1$1")]
[name="林雨霞"]我和这人说几句话，你们等我一会儿。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "right", name = "avg_npc_296_1#7$1",focus="r")]
[charslot(slot = "left", name = "avg_243_waaifu_1#1$1",focus="n")]
[name="杜遥夜"]……好。
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#1$1",duration =0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[name="林雨霞"]没想到肃政院的监察御史还记得我。上次见面应该已经是五年前了？
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_299_1#1$1")]
[name="太合"]那次见面的时机，令人难忘。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#2$1")]
[name="林雨霞"]但不太令人愉快。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_299_1#1$1")]
[name="太合"]公事公办，你我皆是。
[name="太合"]林特使在这里，也是在调查玉门城中事变了？
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#1$1")]
[name="林雨霞"]御史有什么指教？
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_299_1#1$1")]
[name="太合"]不。在下此时并非以官身介入。
[name="太合"]只是作为平祟侯旧部，作为大炎子民，捉拿祸乱百姓安生的奸徒。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#1$1")]
[name="林雨霞"]太合御史这次不劝我置身事外，我反倒是有点意外了。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_299_1#1$1")]
[name="太合"]林特使有职责在身，在下没有理由劝阻。
[name="太合"]请恕在下多事一问。林特使初到玉门，对城中情形还不算熟悉，你打算如何查案？
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#9$1")]
[name="林雨霞"]我当然有自己的手段，不劳太合御史操心。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_299_1#1$1")]
[name="太合"]我也相信林特使的手段，自然有过人之处。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#1$1")]
[name="林雨霞"]太合御史不妨把话说清楚一些。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_299_1#1$1")]
[name="太合"]还是刚才的话，公事公办，仅此而已。
[name="太合"]在下只是来提醒林特使，敌暗我明，千万小心。
[name="太合"]告辞。
[Dialog]
[playsound(key="$d_gen_walk_n")]
[charslot(slot = "m", afrom = 1, ato = 0,duration = 1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#9$1")]
[name="林雨霞"]……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_296_1#1$1",duration =0.5)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_296_1#7$1")]
[name="杜遥夜"]那个大块头，我在尚蜀见过……好像是肃政院的人。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_296_1#9$1")]
[name="杜遥夜"]你到底还认识多少大官？
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_4080_lin_1#1$1")]
[name="林雨霞"]不是认识，只是打过交道。
[charslot(slot = "middle", name = "avg_npc_296_1#9$1")]
[name="杜遥夜"]有什么区别？

contributions.description: 太合当面叫住林雨霞，槐琥杜遥夜同行且现场回应，随后两人稍候太合林雨霞说完话。
